title: EMRT Technical Brief - Stationary Power for a Rotating Electrical Load
description_html:
This technical brief provides a concise engineering orientation to a two-machine Electro-Mechanical Rotational Transformer (EMRT) arrangement for supplying electrical power to a rotating load while keeping the primary source stationary. It summarizes the architecture, declared simulation result, control comparison, energy-accounting rules, communication options, prototype prerequisites, and corpus position.

The work is a simulation brief and experimental plan, not a validated electromechanical product. No hardware run, independent efficiency measurement, fabrication authorization, or safety approval is claimed.

The academic manuscript supplies the full governed reference model, while the conceptual schematics provide the frame, power-path, control, and telemetry diagrams.
